(DEFEXAMPLE READING-OUTSTANDING-CHANGES
  (LET ((NAME (GENSYM WORKFLOW-LIVE-ONLY-INCREMENT-))
        (LOG (MAKE-INSTANCE 'CHANGE-LOG)))
    (SETF (SYMBOL-FUNCTION NAME) (COMPILE NIL '(LAMBDA (X) (+ X 1))))
    (LET ((A (REGISTER-CHANGE NAME LOG)))
      (SETF (SYMBOL-FUNCTION NAME) (COMPILE NIL '(LAMBDA (X) (+ X 2))))
      (LET ((AFTER-REDEFINITION
             (LIST OUTSTANDING (OUTSTANDING-CHANGES LOG) CURRENT
                   (CURRENT-OUTSTANDING-CHANGES LOG) OBSERVATION
                   (OBSERVE-CHANGE A)))
            (B (REGISTER-CHANGE NAME LOG)))
        (LIST LOG LOG A A B B AFTER-REDEFINITION AFTER-REDEFINITION OUTSTANDING
              (OUTSTANDING-CHANGES LOG) CURRENT
              (CURRENT-OUTSTANDING-CHANGES LOG) OBSERVATIONS
              (MAPCAR #'OBSERVE-CHANGE (OUTSTANDING-CHANGES LOG)) SCOPE
              EXPLICIT-REGISTRATIONS-IN-THIS-EXAMPLE)))))
